summary: Acceptance-tested public backend and phone-sized Expo flow. Auth, project creation, mock production, cancel/resume, persisted artifacts, credit protection, download boundary, completion result, and archive navigation passed.
action_items: Keep the documented environment contract consistent: frontend currently reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL while the requested contract names EXPO_BACKEND_URL; current preview works because EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is configured.
critical_code_review_comments: Development providers are MOCKED as expected; final binary download intentionally returns ASSET_NOT_READY/409.
Expo logs contain a non-blocking React Native DevTools Electron sandbox warning, while Metro and the web bundle load successfully.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_-prefixed user and one TEST project/job through the public API; retained for persistence verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL https://fright-forge-19.preview.emergentagent.com. Mock pipeline completes quickly in development mode. The browser run reached completed result and Archive; the final no-error diagnostic was not evaluated due to a test-script quote error.
rca_of_issue: No product failures reproduced. Initial regression assertion expected uppercase email, but register correctly normalizes email to lowercase; the test was corrected and passed.
